<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

  <li><strong>Municipal poll mobilization:</strong> The BJP is actively campaigning for municipal elections in Tripura, with party heavyweights assigned to oversee electoral management and counter anti-incumbency narratives.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
